title: Acquisition-provenance gates and direct specimen-identity controls for deployment-aligned bearing fault diagnosis
description: Versioned reproducibility record for acquisition-provenance qualification, split-unit sensitivity and direct specimen-identity challenges in bearing fault diagnosis. The release contains the frozen 1,200-record public-data inventory, unified logistic evidence, 90-fit spectral-CNN confirmation, finite control audits, a claim-evidence ledger and one-command verification. This is a mixed-license release: author-created code is MIT-licensed, while Paderborn-derived caches and evidence remain subject to CC BY-NC 4.0 and source attribution. See LICENSES.md.
